Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Manoj - 38 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Hema and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "Hema, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav throws the ball to Mother.]

Hema: "That's great!"

[Aarav kicks the football hard.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav plays cricket in the park.]

Hema: "That was fun!"

[Aarav goes down the slide.]

Hema (softly): "I knew it!"

[Aarav plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Hema: "Aarav, look at this."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Aarav stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[Aarav puts on his raincoat.]

Aarav: "Mom, are you okay?"

[The rain stops.]

Aarav: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The bathroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bathroom. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Aarav brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Hema: "And then?"

[Aarav takes a quick bath.]

Aarav: "Oh wow!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Hema and Manoj stand near him.]

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav points at the sky.]

Manoj (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Aarav thinks for a moment.]

Manoj (gently): "Well done!"

[Aarav lights a diya.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav trips over a stone.]

Manoj (laughing): "What next?"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
